column1: # NA 4.VEL 2046 (Plan en defensie van de redout Purmerent, Wollant 1781): the whole text block lower right -- title 2 lines,
# heading, battery lines No.1-3, second heading, lettered legend a-k. Native IIIF region 9000,1800,2450,1400 of 11529x4584
# (images/2046_legend_native.jpg), crops images/crops_2046_leg (tools/iiif_lines.py, command in NOTES.md GAPS18). Two blind Opus
# passes (passes/leg2046_passA.tsv, passB.tsv; brief passes/leg2046_pass_brief.md) aligned by passes/leg2046_merge.py, one blind
# Opus reconciliation (passes/leg2046_reconcile.tsv); built by passes/leg2046_build.py. conf H = both passes agree or the
# reconciliation rated H; M otherwise. GAPS18-na-suriname-map-1781 (account-4), 3 Oct 2026.

column5: note
A:[x-dot] B:x; reconciled H: thick diagonal + thin cross, ball terminal lower-left, separate dot upper-right; same form as L03 pos3, L09 pos4, L11 pos18
A:[ezh] B:3; reconciled H: flat-topped 3; every 3 in this hand (L02 O3w, L03 o3t) has this flat top, so [ezh] and 3 are one shape; use 3
A:[h-tilde] B:h; reconciled M: short mark at the upper right of the h above the shoulder; partly at crop top
A:W B:w; reconciled M: one looped w; it is the large form (loop on left stem) but no second w-shape seen to contrast; use w
A:- B:[d-loop]; reconciled M: tall narrow bowl at x-height with hairline ascender rising very high and curling, same build as the d-loop in L03 'tdl' and L02 pos18; not a plain o
A:o B:[o-flag]; reconciled M: o with hairline flag off the top right, like L03 pos7/13; contrast plain o in L02 '5o[y-dots]'. Flag could be a joining stroke to the d-loop
A:y B:v; reconciled H: x-height v with thick left stroke and foot at baseline, no descender; same form as v in L02 'h v' and L07 pos10; contrast true y with descender in L02 [y-dots]
A:o B:[o-flag]; reconciled M: o with hairline flag top right (sigma-like)
A:o B:[o-flag]; reconciled M: o with hairline flag top right, as pos7

A:[a-dot] B:[delta-grave]; reconciled M: base: angular triangle (thin straight left side, flat thin base, thick right side), i.e. a delta not a round a; mark: grave stroke directly above. The higher dot is over the MM, not this glyph. Same form as L05 pos19; contrast round [a-grave] at L04 pos13 in the same slot -- possibly one character drawn two ways
A:[a-dot] B:[a-grave]; reconciled H: base: round cursive a (bowl + tail); mark: grave stroke above, no dot
A:[diamond] B:[lozenge]; reconciled H: one lozenge with thin inner diagonal and small tail lower-left; use [diamond]
A:[d-loop] B:[amp]; reconciled M: small looped bowl crossed by a short diagonal ending upper-left in a tick; no tall curling ascender, so not the d-loop; identical to L08 pos3

A:[x-dot] B:[delta-dots]; reconciled M: thick diagonal with a dot on each side (lower-left, upper-right) = the x-dot form, plus a grave stroke above; neither reader's code includes the grave; not a delta (no triangle)
A:[3-breve] B:<8>; reconciled M: lower part a 3-bowl with ball at left, upper part an open cup (breve) not joined into a closed loop, so not an 8; same as L06 pos4 (also after MM p)

A:6 B:[d-hook]; reconciled M: bowl with ascender curving right to a hooked/flagged tip; same shape as the numeral 6 in this hand (L10 't6.'); ascender length varies (longest at L11 pos5) -- recheck if the key separates tall vs short
A:[p-dot] B:[p-grave]; reconciled H: base: p; mark: short slanted grave stroke, not a dot
A:o B:[d-hook]; reconciled H: bowl with tall ascender curving right to a ball tip; clearly not o (=6 shape, see L04 pos49)
A:[a-dot] B:[delta-grave]; reconciled M: base: angular delta-like triangle; mark: grave; same as L04 pos3
A:[3-breve] B:<3>; reconciled M: 3 with small cup/breve above; same as L04 pos44 (the 3 in '630' later on this line also carries a small mark above)
A:y B:[1-hook]; reconciled M: single vertical stroke with hook top-left and foot bottom-left; the thin diagonal on its right is a joining hairline to q, not a second arm; not y
A:y B:v; reconciled M: x-height v-form, thick left stroke ending in a small loop at the baseline, thin right arm with ball; no descender; same as L03 pos5
A:[d-loop] B:[amp]; reconciled M: small looped bowl crossed by short diagonal with tick at upper left; identical to L04 pos27; not the tall-ascender d-loop
A:d B:[d-loop]; reconciled H: bowl with hairline ascender curling back left over the 7; d and [d-loop] are one shape here
A:x B:[x-dot]; reconciled H: thick diagonal, dot upper-right, ball lower-left (thin cross faint); same as L01 pos2
A:- B:[d-loop]; reconciled M: small separate bowl with a short stem rising and turning, a clear gap before the long s; short ascender, smaller than usual d-loop
A:3 B:8; reconciled M: closed lower bowl plus small closed upper loop, x-height size; not a 3 (bottom loop closed on the left)
A:5 B:[s-round]; reconciled M: horizontal top flag to the right, short stem, bowl opening left; matches the 5 in L09 'l5#'; contrast [s-hook] (no top bar) at L10 pos23
A:t B:l; reconciled M: sequence is t then l: the second stroke has no crossbar of its own, the t's bar runs into it
A:5 B:[s-hook]; reconciled M: stem on the right with a small hook top-right, curving round the bottom to a ball at left; no horizontal top bar, so not the 5; same as L10 pos59, L11 pos4
A:<h.> B:<h,>; reconciled M: label h; the mark after it sits at/below the baseline with a short downward tail (comma-like), unlike the round period before h; punctuation only
A:6 B:[d-hook]; reconciled M: bowl with ascender curving right to a ball tip; same as the numeral 6 (see L04 pos49)
A:3 B:[s-hook]; reconciled M: ball lower-left, rising right stroke with hook; not a 3 (no flat top, one bowl); as L10 pos23
A:[psi] B:[thorn]; reconciled M: hooked left arm, closed loop on the right, stem descending below the line with a short foot right; the closed right loop rules out psi (two open arms)
A:5 B:[s-hook]; reconciled M: ball lower-left, rising right stem with small hook top-right, no top bar; as L10 pos23
A:6 B:[d-hook]; reconciled M: bowl with a very long ascender sweeping right to a hooked tip; longest instance of the 6/[d-hook] shape
A:[a-dots] B:[delta-dots]; reconciled M: base: pointed triangle with thin left side, thick right side, foot left (same base as L04 pos3, L05 pos19); mark: two dots above
A:x B:[x-dot]; reconciled H: thick diagonal with dot upper-right and dot lower-left; as L01 pos2
